listenings.text: Sophia, it's Ruby. Help! The math test is tomorrow, and I haven't finished my flashcards. My mom says I'd better go to bed early, and she's right, I ought to sleep. But I really should look at the fractions one more time. Can you be my study buddy tonight, just for twenty minutes? We don't have to talk about anything else, I promise. Oh, and you'd better bring your highlighter. Mine ran out of ink!

paras: Exam week is here, and I’ve learned a few things the hard way. First, you had better not cram everything the night before. Last year I pulled an all-nighter before the science test, and the next morning I couldn’t remember a thing. You ought to start a week before, a little every day.

My secret weapon? Flashcards. I write a question on one side and the answer on the other, and my study buddy, Sophia, quizzes me on the bus. You should also try a mind map for history: one big idea in the middle, and everything else around it. And you don’t have to highlight every line. If the whole page is yellow, the highlighter isn’t helping!

Take a brain break every forty minutes: walk, stretch, eat something. And one rule from my teacher: you mustn’t check your phone during the test. Not even the time. Oh, and check the deadline for the history project. Mine is on Friday, so I’d better stop writing this blog now!
